03-20.title: Māori chiefs choose a national flag
03-20.text: Northern chiefs meeting at James Busby's residence at Waitangi chose the flag of the United Tribes, New Zealand's first national flag.

03-20.title: Ngāti Whātua chief signs the Treaty
03-20.text: Apihai Te Kawau of Ngāti Whātua signed the Treaty of Waitangi at the Manukau Harbour. He later offered land for the new capital at Auckland.

03-20.title: Ban on semi-automatic firearms announced
03-20.text: Five days after the Christchurch mosque attacks, Jacinda Ardern announced that military-style semi-automatic weapons would be banned.
